comment: Emit build only. Tests stay type-checked by `check` (plain tsconfig) but are kept out of dist so they never ship in the production image. customConditions drops the base config's `source` condition so @attakk/types resolves to its built .d.ts, not its source — an emitting build cannot pull in a .ts that lives outside rootDir, which is why the Dockerfile builds @attakk/types first.
